text:
Ivy (PM): Heads-up: MedTechCo is asking for our per-route SLOs to match their existing provider for go-live. they want parity on SLA wording + failure modes. alternatively, we can propose a higher-tier bundle with isolation guarantees and guaranteed fallback models. Thoughts?

Omar (Sales): they'll pay for isolation if it's priced reasonably. but the procurement team tends to prefer parity for quicker sign-off. Legal will push for explicit failure descriptions.

Hector (Eng): parity on SLA language is mostly doc work, but isolation guarantees require Dedicated pool + network isolation (2-3 weeks ops/setup). Fallbacks: we can promise automated fallback to a compatible smaller model during capacity shortfall. implementable in 1 sprint as a policy.

Nina (Design): if we offer isolation as a premium, we need to update the onboarding flow and console UX to surface tenant isolation status and fallback indicators. small UI changes but important for trust.

Keith (Legal): parity wording mustn't create unlimited liability. we can match language but with explicit caps and exclusions for third-party model regressions.

Ivy (PM): proposed compromise: sign pilot with parity-language but include a "tiered delivery" schedule: week 0-2: functional parity + fallback; week 3-5: isolation provisioning for paid customers. include credits/adjustment if isolation not available by GA.

Hector (Eng): plan:
- sprint 1: fallback model routing + per-route SLA metrics visible in console
- sprint 2: provisioning scripts for Dedicated + network isolation
- sprint 3: UX polish + telemetry

PipelinesBot: infra/provision-isolation - terraform apply queued.

Omar (Sales): i'll message procurement to accept staged delivery. they prefer staged if credits are in place.

Keith (Legal): i'll craft parity-friendly SLA language with liability caps and a clause about scheduled provisioning windows.

Ivy (PM): decision: accept pilot with parity wording + staged isolation delivery. owners: Hector (eng), Omar (sales), Keith (legal). i will post SOW draft today.

Hector (Eng): starting work on fallback routing RFC and console metrics endpoint.

Nina (Design): will mock quick console banners to show isolation status and fallback engaged.

PipelinesBot: update - apply started on staging-iso-01.

Ivy (PM): closing thread. tag me for blockers. :v:
